protocol.maps: The unchanged 24 radius_stress_cases: 3 families x 2 layouts x 4 rotations

variants.ranking_local: Ranking checkpoint, b(s,a)=the true successor distance; closed ball including ties
variants.ranking_global: Same ranking checkpoint; one epsilon_max pooled over all 24 stress maps per seed
variants.regression_local: Original regression checkpoint, same oracle local construction; geometry control
variants.regression_global: Original checkpoint and pooled epsilon_max; reproduce every saved historical maximum-radius candidate set and CTL score
variants.ranking_top1: Frozen c15c457 Top-1 graph, checked against its saved export
variants.all_states: All valid same-map successors for every action; negative control

protocol.distance: Unnormalised Euclidean distance between float32 network outputs, computed using direct float64 cdist (no matrix-multiply shortcut), exactly as in the historical radius evaluator. Audit full rankings against independent direct subtraction and canonical float32 Top-1.
protocol.sorting: Ascending distance with original state index breaking ties. Export full distances and ordered indices, true rank, d1/d2/d3, d_true, d2-d1, tie count and deterministic Top-1/2/3 coverage. Oracle balls include the entire boundary tie block.
protocol.spurious_edge_rate: Pooled action-labelled spurious edges / all included action-labelled edges. Also report extra edges per true edge and unlabelled edge counts separately.
protocol.formal_pipeline: Existing greatest simulation/bisimulation and native CTL on every variant. Existing nuXmv CTL sanity and all six LTL formulas on ranking_local, ranking_global and regression_global. Reuse hash-checked ranking_top1 temporal records; prove/check controls separately. Same states, labels, initial states, graph encoding and no fairness. Legacy backend export key top1 is an explicitly labelled adapter for the candidate graph, not a new point prediction.
protocol.proving_power: Reuse the historical non-immediate primary CTL opportunities for AG !danger, EF goal and E[!danger U goal]. Separately report all/initial/non-immediate ACTL and universally interpreted LTL true-proof recall, denominators and false claims. AF goal has no non-immediate positive opportunity on this suite; report N/A, not evidence of useful liveness proving power.

continue_gate.interpretation: Engineering feasibility screen, not a statistical significance test. Every seed must pass; no post-result threshold or checkpoint changes. Required proof families remain sealed_region and danger_gate.

protocol.scope: Oracle best-case diagnostic within the fixed distance-ball family. No training, architecture changes, new temporal formulas, validation/test-fitted estimator, conformal/PAC, or claim of a deployable unknown-R error bound. Full oracle truth is used only to construct/evaluate the diagnostic bounds and exact controls. Stop after this study and report whether to consider bound estimation in a later stage.

publication_scope: Aggregate metrics only: pooled and per-seed controls, plus the complete requested seed/family/action breakdown for ranking/local and both predictors' rankings. Full per-query data, all control cross-groups and certificates are in the private record archive.
